title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
read_scope: Official proceedings metadata, abstract and PDF introduction; selective reading.
method_overlap: DAgger addresses learning on the distribution of states induced by the learner's own decisions. This principle is prior art for autonomous adaptation controllers.
limitation: Its expert-feedback and reduction assumptions must not be silently transferred to unlabeled target TTA. Auxiliary labeled rollouts are development supervision.
publication_status: Official AISTATS proceedings verified on 26 October 2026.

title: Test-Time Training with Self-Supervision for Generalization under Distribution Shifts
read_scope: Official metadata, abstract and PDF introduction/method summary, not full experimental audit.
method_overlap: Learns from an auxiliary self-supervised task at test time; online variant retains updates. Gradient alignment gives a restricted condition for improvement.
limitation: Requires source-stage preparation of the auxiliary task. Our interpretation: improvement of that task need not imply improvement of classification on a new shift.
publication_status: ICML 2020 official proceedings; linked 2019 preprint is the same work.

title: Do We Really Need to Access the Source Data? Source Hypothesis Transfer for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
read_scope: Official proceedings metadata and abstract only.
method_overlap: Freezes the source classifier and adapts the target feature extractor with information maximization and pseudo-labeling; foundational source-free adaptation comparator.
limitation: Source-free domain adaptation is not automatically one-pass online TTA. Target access, clustering passes and source training must be matched before numerical comparison.

title: Improving robustness against common corruptions by covariate shift adaptation
venue: NeurIPS 2020, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33
read_scope: Official abstract, PDF introduction and normalization formulation; selective reading.
method_overlap: Replacing or interpolating BatchNorm statistics is a strong, cheap corruption baseline, including on robust source checkpoints.
limitation: Moment correction assumes useful shared target statistics; mixed conditions and class-mixture effects constrain it. Small batches require estimation/shrinkage choices.

title: Test-Time Classifier Adjustment Module for Model-Agnostic Domain Generalization
venue: NeurIPS 2021, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34
read_scope: Official proceedings abstract and metadata; PDF first page.
method_overlap: Updates pseudo-prototype class templates using unlabeled features without backpropagation; important inexpensive alternative to parameter adaptation.
limitation: Our interpretation: pseudo-prototype quality depends on source features and pseudo-labels. Its DG source-training protocol differs from single-source corruption experiments.

title: Parameter-Free Online Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Official abstract/metadata and PDF objective/cross-shift validation passages.
method_overlap: Conservative graph-regularized output correction with frozen model parameters; already studies failure of scenario-specific tuning across shifts.
limitation: Our interpretation: graph quality and the number/composition of simultaneously available samples limit refinement. Parameter-free does not mean hyperparameter-free.
publication_status: Official CVPR proceedings and author repository verified.

title: MEMO: Test Time Robustness via Adaptation and Augmentation
venue: NeurIPS 2022, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
read_scope: Official metadata/abstract and PDF introductory method description.
method_overlap: Minimizes entropy of predictions averaged over augmented views of one input; removes a multi-input batch requirement.
limitation: Our interpretation: multiple views and adaptation cost must be charged; the chosen transformations encode invariance assumptions that can fail under severe shifts.

title: The Norm Must Go On: Dynamic Unsupervised Domain Adaptation by Normalization
read_scope: Official metadata/abstract and PDF first-page adaptive-momentum description.
method_overlap: Continuously updates BN statistics with adaptive momentum from limited unlabeled data; dynamic statistics control predates the proposed router.
limitation: BN-dependent; our interpretation is that statistics updates cannot recover arbitrary lost semantic features and can mix incompatible stream conditions.
publication_status: Official CVPR proceedings verified; related 2021 preprint linked work.

title: Test-Time Training with Masked Autoencoders
venue: NeurIPS 2022, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
read_scope: Official abstract, metadata, PDF introduction and source repository overview.
method_overlap: Single-sample reconstruction-based adaptation supplies a self-supervised alternative to confidence minimization.
limitation: Requires a reconstruction-compatible source setup. Our interpretation: reconstruction quality and classification utility can diverge; runtime includes repeated adaptation.

title: Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Zero-Shot Generalization in Vision-Language Models
venue: NeurIPS 2022, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
read_scope: Official proceedings abstract/metadata and repository setting descriptions.
method_overlap: Optimizes text prompts on confidence-selected augmented views of a single test image for CLIP zero-shot classification.
limitation: VLM setup and multiple views differ from CNN BN adaptation; source/pretrained prompt initialization and adaptation latency must be declared.

title: RDumb: A simple approach that questions our progress in continual test-time adaptation
venue: NeurIPS 2023, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
read_scope: Official metadata/abstract and selected PDF collapse/toy-model appendix passages.
method_overlap: Introduces CCC long streams and a periodic-reset baseline that challenges apparent continual-adaptation gains.
limitation: Our interpretation: fixed resets discard useful state and introduce a schedule, but sophisticated controllers must first beat this inexpensive comparator.

title: Robust Mean Teacher for Continual and Gradual Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Official metadata, abstract and PDF introduction describing source-free/source-data variants and DomainNet-126.
method_overlap: Symmetric consistency loss and source-anchored contrastive adaptation for continual/gradual shifts; establishes continual DomainNet-126 protocol.
limitation: Source-access and source-free variants differ; teachers, augmentation and contrastive computation must be charged. Our interpretation: pseudo-label error remains a constraint.

title: Rapid Network Adaptation: Learning to Adapt Neural Networks Using Test-Time Feedback
read_scope: Indexed official CVF PDF title block/abstract/introduction and author project adaptation-signal descriptions; full training rollouts not audited.
locations: Author project Employed Test-time Adaptation Signals
method_overlap: Learns an amortized adaptation controller from error feedback; closed-loop learned updates and controller terminology are prior art.
limitation: Classification examples use coarse/retrieval feedback from labeled training images; depth uses sparse geometric feedback. Not a weights-only unlabeled comparator. Exact training-state coverage remains to check; project code link is not verified RNA code.
publication_status: Official ICCV PDF and author site verified; CVF HTML returned 403 during refresh.

title: Unified Entropy Optimization for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Official abstract/metadata and PDF first-page setup.
method_overlap: Separates candidate known/unknown inputs and applies opposing entropy objectives; selecting an objective according to shift/sample type is established.
limitation: Our interpretation: noisy unknown/known partitions can corrupt adaptation. Closed-set accuracy alone misses unknown detection failures; its open-set scope is separate.

title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
read_scope: Official CVF PDF first page, efficiency/comparison passages and author repository.
method_overlap: Dynamic positive/negative pseudo-label caches refine CLIP outputs without gradient updates; a useful inexpensive VLM reference.
limitation: Our interpretation: caches depend on feature/pseudo-label quality and history. Backbone and natural-shift protocol must match; published timing is device-specific.
publication_status: Official CVF PDF verified; HTML access returned 403.

title: Free on the Fly: Enhancing Flexibility in Test-Time Adaptation with Online EM
read_scope: Official abstract/metadata and PDF comparison passages only.
method_overlap: Models target distributions using online expectation-maximization and zero-shot VLM priors without retaining individual past test samples.
limitation: The abstract's 'no assumptions' is author framing, not accepted literally here. Our interpretation: model family and pseudo-posterior assumptions still govern updates.
publication_status: Official CVPR 2025 proceedings verified; 2025 arXiv is linked version.

title: Mint: A Simple Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models against Common Corruptions
venue: NeurIPS 2025, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
read_scope: Official proceedings PDF first page and primary arXiv abstract/metadata; partial reading.
method_overlap: Targets corruption-related collapse of embedding variance by maximizing estimated inter-class variance using accumulators.
limitation: Our interpretation: pseudo-label-based variance estimates can change with class priors; successful corruption adaptation does not establish arbitrary mixed-prior robustness.
publication_status: NeurIPS 2025 main proceedings PDF verified, beyond author-reported arXiv acceptance.

title: The Golden Subspace: Where Efficiency Meets Generalization in Continual Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Official CVF metadata and abstract only.
method_overlap: Low-rank directional feature adaptation with online subspace maintenance addresses efficiency/generalization in continual classification and segmentation.
limitation: The stated subspace result is restricted to a single-step setting; no general multi-step stability theorem was verified. Full empirical protocol remains to read.

title: Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Primary metadata, abstract, introduction, Sections 3.1–3.3 and setting table; selective reading.
method_overlap: Learns offline hidden-trajectory correction adapters; online entropy optimization changes correction-strength scalars. Intermediate-feature shift gates are prior art.
limitation: Source-free training still uses corrupted/further-corrupted pairs; Table 1 describes episodic online adaptation. Held-out-family training details need full audit before comparisons.
publication_status: Preprint submitted 16 October 2026; no accepted venue verified.
